# Android System Design & Architecture 1:1 Mentorship — Full Knowledge Specification

> Author & Mentor: Kate Lint (Principal Android Engineer & Mobile System Architect)
> Canonical URL: https://mentoringandroid.com
> Format: Intensive 90-Minute 1:1 Video Session with Live Collaborative Architecture Whiteboarding

## 1. Overview & Mentor Pedigree
Kate Lint is a Principal Android Systems Architect and veteran mobile engineering leader who has built and scaled high-traffic applications to tens of millions of active users. Her mentorship program is designed specifically for engineers preparing for Senior, Staff, and Principal Android interviews at Tier-1 tech companies (FAANG/MAMAA, Unicorns, and high-growth fintech/e-commerce platforms) as well as engineers leading large-scale legacy codebase modernizations.

## 2. Program Structure & Deliverables (90-Minute Intensive)
Every mentee receives:
- **1x 90-Minute Dedicated 1:1 Live Session**: Real-time collaborative deep-dive over Google Meet with live Miro/Excalidraw whiteboard architectural diagrams.
- **Custom Production Architecture Blueprint**: Tailored architectural diagram (Clean Architecture, MVI, unidirectional data flow, multi-module dependency graphs) addressing the mentee's specific challenges.
- **Performance & Compose Optimization Audit**: Line-by-line inspection of recomposition hotspots, memory leak diagnostics, frame drop analysis, and baseline profiles.
- **Private Video Recording & Timestamped Action Plan**: Full recording of the session plus a written markdown roadmap with prioritized milestones.
- **7-Day Direct Async Follow-up Access**: 1 week of direct Slack/email Q&A for architectural review and resume/design document critique.

## 3. Core Curriculum Modules
1. **Module 1: Modern Android Architecture at Scale**
   - Clean Architecture, Hexagonal patterns, and Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF / MVI).
   - Multi-module project structures (feature modules, core libraries, navigation graphs, dynamic feature delivery).
   - Dependency Injection at scale using Dagger/Hilt and Koin, including custom scopes and test doubles.

2. **Module 2: Jetpack Compose Deep-Dive & Recomposition Internals**
   - Compose runtime architecture, `SnapshotState`, restartable vs. skippable composables.
   - Compose compiler metrics, Stability inference (`@Immutable`, `@Stable`), derived state optimization.
   - Migrating complex legacy View-based systems and custom Canvas components to Compose.

3. **Module 3: Mobile System Design Interview Framework**
   - Structured 45-minute interview delivery: Scope Clarification -> High-Level Design -> Deep Dive -> Scale & Bottlenecks.
   - Offline-first data synchronization, conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs), Room database indexing, and SQLite WAL mode.
   - Network resiliency, retry exponential backoff, caching tiers, and battery-conscious background processing (WorkManager).

4. **Module 4: Performance Profiling, Memory, and Benchmarking**
   - Macrobenchmark, Microbenchmark, Baseline Profiles, and R8/Proguard optimization.
   - Memory leak analysis with LeakCanary and Android Studio Memory Profiler.
   - App startup time optimization (Cold start time reduction, Splash Screen API, Lazy initialization).

## 4. Formal Scheduling & Policy Guarantees
- **OPA (Open Policy Agent) Policy-as-Code**: Intake quality, email verification, and advance booking notice rules are evaluated deterministically using declarative Rego policies (`lib/policies/booking-policy.rego`).
- **Z3-Inspired SMT Constraint Solver**: Prevents booking collisions, guarantees strict 15-minute inter-session buffer margins, enforces a maximum of 3 mentoring sessions per day to prevent mentor burnout, and restricts slots to verified business hours.
- **Rescheduling Policy**: Mentees can reschedule up to 24 hours prior to session start with 1-click self-service.
- **100% Money-Back Guarantee**: If a mentee completes the 90-minute session and feels it did not deliver actionable, transformative value, a full no-questions-asked refund is processed within 7 business days.
